sdgs.title: No Poverty
sdgs.description: Ensuring every child and family has shelter, clothes, and basic needs.
sdgs.story: Imagine a big blanket that covers everyone in the community. When we share books, clothes, and warm smiles, we make sure nobody feels left out or cold!

sdgs.title: Zero Hunger
sdgs.description: Growing healthy food and making sure no tummy goes hungry.
sdgs.story: Plants grow from tiny seeds into yummy apples, crunchy carrots, and sweet berries! Eating good food gives us energy to play, run, and learn.

sdgs.title: Good Health & Well-being
sdgs.description: Eating fresh veggies, getting strong through play, and resting well.
sdgs.story: Your body is an amazing adventure machine! Drinking water, dancing to music, and laughing with friends keeps your heart super strong.

sdgs.title: Quality Education
sdgs.description: Opening books, asking curious questions, and discovering new things everyday.
sdgs.story: Every book is a magic portal to a new world. When we read and ask questions, our brains grow super muscle powers!

sdgs.title: Gender Equality
sdgs.description: Girls and boys can be scientists, artists, astronauts, or whatever they dream!
sdgs.story: Whether building robot rockets or painting giant murals, boys and girls can do anything they set their minds to!

sdgs.title: Clean Water & Sanitation
sdgs.description: Protecting Earth’s precious water drops so humans, animals, and plants stay hydrated.
sdgs.story: Water travels all around Earth — in clouds, rivers, oceans, and taps! Turning off the tap while brushing saves hundreds of drops every single day.

sdgs.title: Affordable & Clean Energy
sdgs.description: Using sunlight, wind, and waves to power our lamps and toys cleanly.
sdgs.story: The sun sends free clean energy from 93 million miles away! Solar panels turn sunlight right into electricity for our computers and nightlights.

sdgs.title: Decent Work & Economic Growth
sdgs.description: Creating fun, safe, and helpful work where people are rewarded fairly.
sdgs.story: When people do jobs they love — like growing apples, teaching coding, or designing parks — the whole neighborhood prospers together!

sdgs.title: Industry, Innovation & Infrastructure
sdgs.description: Building eco-friendly trains, strong bridges, and smart inventions.
sdgs.story: Inventors use creativity to build solar-powered buses, recycled plastic roads, and windmills that make our cities super cool and clean.

sdgs.title: Reduced Inequalities
sdgs.description: Treating all people with kindness, fairness, and inclusion.
sdgs.story: Everyone brings a special color to our world rainbow. When we make sure playground ramps and games include everyone, playing becomes twice as fun!

sdgs.title: Sustainable Cities & Communities
sdgs.description: Designing neighborhoods with parks, bike paths, and fresh clean air.
sdgs.story: Imagine cities filled with rooftop flower gardens, quiet electric buses, and big sunny parks where birds sing and children play safely!

sdgs.title: Responsible Consumption & Production
sdgs.description: Using only what we need, recycling toys & paper, and reducing waste.
sdgs.story: Instead of throwing old things away, we can turn cardboard boxes into castle forts, compost apple cores into garden soil, and swap books with friends!

sdgs.title: Climate Action
sdgs.description: Planting trees, saving energy, and protecting Earth’s climate balance.
sdgs.story: Earth is like our cozy home with an atmosphere blanket. When we plant trees and walk or bike instead of driving short trips, we keep Earth cool and happy!

sdgs.title: Life Below Water
sdgs.description: Keeping seas clean for sea turtles, playful dolphins, and colorful fish.
sdgs.story: Underneath the blue waves lives an enchanted kingdom of sea turtles, glowing jellyfish, and coral castles! Keeping trash off beaches protects ocean creatures.

sdgs.title: Life on Land
sdgs.description: Protecting wild animals, green forests, soil bugs, and buzzing honeybees.
sdgs.story: Forests are giant living homes for butterflies, squirrels, foxes, and birds. Every seed planted creates a new shelter and snack for woodland animals!

sdgs.title: Peace, Justice & Strong Institutions
sdgs.description: Solving arguments with peaceful words, sharing, and playing fair.
sdgs.story: When friends disagree, taking a deep breath and listening helps us understand each other. Peace begins with a friendly smile and warm words!

sdgs.title: Partnerships for the Goals
sdgs.description: Working together across schools, families, and countries to save Earth!
sdgs.story: When many small hands join together, big wonderful things happen! Combining our ideas, kindness, and action makes us an unstoppable Earth Team!

missions.title: Become a Water Saver 💧
missions.challengeText: Turn off the water tap while brushing your teeth for 3 full days!
missions.bonusText: Find one more creative way your family can save water at home (e.g. collecting rainwater for plants).
checklistItems: Shared a water-saving tip with family 💬

missions.title: Plant a Green Sprout 🌿
missions.challengeText: Plant a seed in a small pot, cup, or garden and give it water & sunlight!
missions.bonusText: Draw a picture of your seedling or write a friendly note to your plant.

missions.title: Recycling Detective ♻️
missions.challengeText: Inspect your home waste and sort 5 items into paper, plastic, or compost!
missions.bonusText: Make a funny toy or fort out of an empty cardboard box.

missions.title: Energy Lights-Out Patrol ⚡
missions.challengeText: Walk around your home and switch off lights in empty rooms before bedtime.
missions.bonusText: Calculate how many lights your family turns off in 1 day!

missions.title: Rainbow Plate Challenge 🍎
missions.challengeText: Eat 3 different colorful fruits or veggies in one day!
missions.bonusText: Do 20 jumping jacks or dance to your favorite song for 5 minutes!
checklistItems: Drank a big glass of water 💧
